Business tour's Update!
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26629331/b4aaede0a331111d6cca5db29e479c4b5c1ce232.jpg[/img]
Friends, can you dream? And how often do your dreams remain dreams? 
How to change this?
Martin Luther King will tell you!
Should you follow him and he will lead to the fulfillment of all your plans for sure. 
He will teach a workshop of wish-granting and direct straight to victory!

Registration for his workshop is now open!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/865210/Business_tour_Great_Leaders_King/

notes.content:
It's our pleasure to inform you that our game will be available soon.ːsteamhappyː
